Variants.Content: When facing a crisis in the West, the most reliable thing is not the legendary hero, but the long-established way of survival. In times of crisis, wealth can quickly turn into armor and alliances, making the Western Territory a target that everyone wants to pressure or plunder; this also determines why the locals will people follow, and when will they turn around?
